about_the_game:
The Blood Moon descends, and the mortal realm falls into purgatory.

The Lord of Lingxu Palace burns away body and soul, reshaping the cultivators’ forms, granting a seven-day reprieve.

Baptized in blood and fire, they stand with no way back.

Break the siege, slay the fiends, and overturn the heavens!

A Seven-Day Last Stand

In the seventh year of Zhushang, the heavens shuddered as the Blood Moon appeared.

Its crimson radiance corroded hearts and souls; all beings fell under its sway, slowly twisting into fiends.

For over a decade, the calamity raged on. Defenders perished on the battlefield or succumbed to corruption; even mighty cultivators who sought the Blood Moon’s source never returned. As the scourge grew, demonic armies pressed ever closer, and the mortal realm stood on the brink of ruin.

Under this oppressive tide, only a handful of steadfast and powerful cultivators abandoned their bodies, casting forth their primordial spirits to the Lingxu Palace, escaping corruption for a time.

At the brink of annihilation, the Lord of Lingxu Palace unearthed the Eye of Zhulong atop Mount Zhong, dispersing a fragment of the Blood Moon’s glow. He then burned his own soul and body, invoking the forbidden Soul-Return Ritual to restore fallen cultivators, buying a seven-day reprieve.

Within those seven days, you will awaken up to three cultivators, lead them against the demonic hordes and mighty bosses, confront the truth of the Blood Moon, and strive to overturn fate itself.

Real-time control, team coordination—or stand alone against the darkness

Command up to three cultivators in real time, freely switching between characters and perspectives.

With MOBA/RTS-inspired controls, the game tests your positioning, skill timing, and teamwork.

You may also choose to fight alone, standing against the horde by yourself. (The game is designed with builds tailored for solo, duo, or trio control, ensuring diverse playstyles are supported.)

Wave Defense and Boss Battles

Enemy hordes surge like an endless tide, with each wave escalating in difficulty: regular waves test your basic defenses, elite waves introduce stronger foes, and the final wave of each day culminates in a Boss fight. On the seventh day, the ultimate Boss awaits.

Each wave is randomly generated from various enemy types, ensuring every battle is filled with unpredictability and challenge.

Roguelike Randomness & Multi-layered Builds

  • Randomized waves, monsters, drops, chests, and rewards

  • Global deck-building choices that shape each run

  • Freely combine skills, equipment, and hero synergies

Every seven-day cycle offers a brand-new challenge and the evolution of unique builds.

Fragmented Storytelling

The truth behind the Blood Moon lies scattered among fragmented tales and hero stories.

Only by piecing together memories and clues, and unlocking more cultivators, can the ultimate secret of the Blood Moon be revealed.

Through side quests and story progression, players can gradually unlock new gameplay elements or deepen their builds, ensuring every cycle feels fresh and full of surprises.

Diverse Heroes and Synergies

Choose from dozens of cultivators, each with distinct roles, skills, and synergy effects, allowing you to forge a truly unique defensive lineup.

Future Updates and Expansions

The game will continue to receive content and mode updates, actively incorporating player feedback. Future plans may include new cultivators, items, and bosses, as well as new modes (such as Endless Mode, Co-op Mode) and DLC, bringing even greater variety to the experience. Stay tuned!

short_description: ‘Blood Moon: Last Stand’ is an action-strategy game set in Xianxia, blending wave defense, real-time control, and roguelike deck-building. Command up to three cultivators, forge unique builds, and withstand relentless hordes and bosses. Survive seven days to overturn fate.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
